note: Real captured mainnet XDR. Used by table-driven tests. Do not regenerate casually: tests assert on decoded content. Constructed fixtures are listed separately under 'constructed'.

synthetic_fixtures.note: Synthetic payloads built with xdr.MarshalBase64 for XDR types that never appear as standalone Horizon payloads (issues #6-#9). Not captured from the network: fields are deterministic test vectors with filled hashes and fixed sequence numbers. hot_archive_bucket_entry is byte-identical to the corresponding BucketEntry arm on the wire, so decode it with an explicit --type.

ledger_header.description: Ledger 55278432; exercises stroop notes for TotalCoins/FeePool/BaseFee/BaseReserve and the protocol-version note.

ledger_header_history.description: History entry wrapping the same header; exercises hash notes on Hash and Header.

bucket_entry_live.description: LIVEENTRY wrapping an account ledger entry with a stroop balance.

bucket_entry_dead.description: DEADENTRY tombstone for a TTL ledger key.

bucket_entry_meta.description: METAENTRY at protocol 22 with the live bucket list type.

bucket_metadata.description: Standalone bucket metadata; on the wire this collides with ScVal encodings, so detection may report both.

hot_archive_bucket_entry.description: ARCHIVED arm of the hot archive bucket; byte-identical to BucketEntry on the wire — decode with an explicit --type.

scp_envelope.description: EXTERNALIZE envelope for slot 55278000 from validator GBIFCUSTKRKVMV2YLFNFWXC5LZPWAYLCMNSGKZTHNBUWU23MNVXG6NJZ.

scp_statement.description: Bare EXTERNALIZE statement without the envelope signature.

scp_quorum_set.description: Threshold 2 of 3 validators plus a nested 1-of-1 inner set.

ledger_key_ttl.description: TTL variant of LedgerKey, the state-archival deletion key.

ledger_entry_ttl.description: TTL ledger entry wrapping a TtlEntry payload.

eviction_iterator.description: Eviction iterator at bucket list level 6.

overlay_hello.description: Overlay hello from a Core 22.0.0 peer on the mainnet network id, listening on 11625 (issue #21).

overlay_auth.description: Overlay auth reply with the require-auth flag set; only four bytes, so decode with an explicit --type.

overlay_dont_have.description: DontHave for a tx_set request; short and aliased by LedgerKey/TtlEntry, so decode with an explicit --type.

overlay_peer_address.description: IPv4 peer address 192.0.2.1:11625 with no failures.

overlay_peer_address_v6.description: IPv6 peer address [2001:db8::1]:11625 with two failed connections.

overlay_auth_cert.description: Standalone peer authentication certificate with a fixed curve25519 key and 64-byte signature.

overlay_error.description: Overlay error with code err_conf and a message.

overlay_stellar_message.description: StellarMessage wrapping the hello fixture, the way a peer receives it.

overlay_peers.description: Peers message carrying the IPv4 and IPv6 peer address fixtures as a list.

tx_history_entry_v0.description: History entry for ledger 55278432 with a legacy v0 transaction set holding one v0 payment (issue #22).

tx_history_entry_v1.description: History entry for ledger 55278433 whose extension carries a generalized transaction set.

tx_history_result_entry.description: Result entry for ledger 55278432 with one successful payment result.

generalized_tx_set.description: Generalized v1 set with a classic component phase and a parallel execution phase.

ledger_close_meta_batch.description: Empty batch bounds for ledger 55278432; carries no per-ledger meta.

asset_native.description: The native asset, four zero bytes; exercises the mainnet and testnet SAC contract ids (issue #24).

asset_usdc.description: USDC issued by GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN; its mainnet SAC id is CCW67TSZV3SSS2HXMBQ5JFGCKJNXKZM7UQUWUZPUTHXSTZLEO7SJMI75.

data_entry_text.description: JSON config value: valid printable UTF-8, so it must render as text (issue #17).

data_entry_binary.description: PNG signature as the value: invalid UTF-8, so it must render as hex (issue #17).

account_entry_ext_v1.description: Liabilities of 150/25 XLM in the v1 extension; exercises the stroop amount notes and the liabilities discriminant note (issue #15).

account_entry_ext_v2.description: Two signers with one sponsored reserve (NumSponsored 1, NumSponsoring 2) (issue #15).

account_entry_ext_v3.description: V2 extension whose V3 carries SeqLedger 55278432 and SeqTime 1780000000 (issue #15).

contract_code.description: Synthetic 699-byte WASM module with contractspecv0 (all six declaration kinds), contractenvmetav0 (host protocol 22) and contractmetav0 (rsver/rssdkver) custom sections (issue #10).

contract_code_v1.description: ContractCodeEntry ext v1 with cost inputs; a bare module with no metadata sections, so Spec/EnvMeta/Meta are absent (issue #10).

survey_request.description: Surveyor requests the topology of one peer for ledger 55278432; the command type and peer encryption key are enriched (issue #20).

survey_response.description: Response carrying a 24-byte encrypted topology body for ledger 55278432 (issue #20).

survey_stop.description: Stop-collecting command; byte-identical to survey_start on the wire, so decode it with an explicit --type (issue #20).
